work.title: The Life of King Henry the Fifth
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 5, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. France. A royal palace.

content.text: Enter at one door, King Henry, Exeter, Bedford, Warwick, Gloucester, Westmorland, Clarence, Huntingdon and other Lords. At another, Queen Isabel, the French King, the Princess Katharine, Alice, and other Ladies; the Duke of Burgundy and other French.
[Exeunt all except Henry, Katharine and Alice.]
Enter the French Power and the English Lords.
